summary: Withhold automatic manufacturing research for placeable recipes with no useful productivity bonus.
details: Require a canonical productive item identity and finite positive fixed quantity with useful bonus remaining in every retained placeable-output variant. Apply the shared target-specific productivity exclusion, including the inherited modern ignored_by_stats default and explicit-zero precedence.

The new non_productive_placeable_output blocker cannot be overridden by a compatibility attachment. Existing single-output, deterministic-output, permission, risk, owner and cardinality gates remain in force. No technology, setting or request identity changes.

Controlled canonical facts, risk and operator checks preserve useful opposing cases and retained hazard rejections. The already-registered negative fixture now includes zero-quantity and fully excluded outputs. Actual current-package fixture, catalogue/removal and saved-world acceptance remain pending.
